appDescription: Gleo Health checks seat belts for every occupied seat, paces driving rest breaks, and shows a seat-safety score that drivers can share with a partner insurer for discounts.

function.name: CHECK_SEAT_AND_BELTS
function.description: Check which seats are occupied and whether each occupied seat has its seat belt buckled, then tell the user any seat that still needs buckling.

function.name: MY_SEAT_HEALTH_SCORE
function.description: Tell the user the seat-safety score for the current trip or this month, made of 80 percent seat belt use and 20 percent rest breaks.

function.name: FIND_REST_STOP
function.description: Open the navigation place search for rest areas so the driver can pick one and add it as a stop.
